name: Figurine of Wondrous Power (Golden Lions)

source.note: Entered from knowledge of the 2024 DMG (personal build); check every number against the book.

powers.name: Animate
powers.text: Magic action: throw it to a spot within 60 ft: it becomes two Lions for up to 1 hours, then can't be used again for 7 days.

summary: Becomes two Lions that serves you for up to 1 hours (once every 7 days).
text: Small enough for a pocket, this statuette comes alive when you use a Magic action to hurl it at a spot on the ground up to 60 feet away, turning into two Lions. If something already occupies that space, the transformation fails. The Lions regard you and your allies as friends, know your languages and do as you say; given no orders, they defend themselves and otherwise do nothing. After up to 1 hour they become a figurine once more, or sooner if they are reduced to 0 Hit Points or you touch them and use a Magic action to end the transformation. Once it reverts, the figurine needs 7 days before it works again.
